svg.title: Stereo-Collision-Warning pipeline
svg.desc: Pipeline. Left and right camera frames are paired and rectified, then go to stereo depth and to detection and tracking. Both feed a per-object distance, which a Kalman filter turns into distance and closing speed per track. The risk engine uses ego speed from GPS to compute time-to-collision and headway, and raises collision and tailgating warnings, which save event clips.
